description: Source file implementing a cache for MIME supportability information, including functions for parsing MIME attributes, managing cache entries, and supporting supportability queries.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache
classes.description: Manages caching and querying of MIME supportability information, including support for bitrate support checks.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry holding parsed MIME info and bitrate support bounds.

methods.name: GetMimeSupportability
methods.description: Returns supportability info for a given MIME string, considering bitrate.

methods.name: CacheMimeSupportability
methods.description: Caches supportability info for a given MIME string.

methods.name: ClearCachedMimeSupportabilities
methods.description: Clears all cached MIME supportability entries.

methods.name: DumpCache
methods.description: Outputs the current cache state for debugging.
